text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...Curren had a scary dream.
A dream where a fake Curren was pretending to be me."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
And yet, everyone is saying
that Curren is the fake one...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: The real Curren is definitely way cuter though...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
*sniffle*... If it's you, Big Brother,
you'd be able to tell us apart, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
*sniffle*... If it's you, Big Sister,
you'd be able to tell us apart, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems Curren Chan hasn't been sleeping well due to nightmares...
